notes: Scan prioritised 2026-10-09 through 2026-10-16 and covered the 2026-09-30 through 2026-10-08 interval since the 2026-09-29 catch-up; older omitted studies are marked NEWLY_DISCOVERED, never NEW.

The Lai et al. journal and university records specify October 2026 without a reliable day, so publication_date records the known year rather than inventing a day; the Max Planck seminar programme has no verified posting date, so its event dates are not treated as publication dates.
Consensus discovery was run across all nine radars; the retained Ren record was fetched (Consensus ID 12531827b8065d769185562e78e257ee) and independently verified against the publisher.

No long-lived gap state change or new Baseline is justified: results sharpen short-task reflection and stage-specific delegation but do not resolve long-term retention, expert trajectories, mechanisms, behavioural validity or collective-cultural persistence.
